Remortgaging in Norwich & Norfolk

When your fixed rate ends, doing nothing often means rolling onto your lender standard variable rate. We review your current deal, early repayment charges and whether switching saves money after fees.

  • Review 3–6 months before rate ends
  • Compare product transfer vs new lender
  • Early repayment charge guidance
  • Realistic timelines and paperwork support

Frequently asked questions

When should I start looking?

Many clients start 3–6 months before their rate ends so there is time to compare options without rushing.

Can you guarantee savings?

No. We model costs honestly including fees—sometimes staying with your lender is the right choice.
